DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger (Extensor Tendon Rupture).

Based on your description of the finger being extended at rest, inability to flex the distal joint, and the history of forced flexion during football, the extensor tendon has likely ruptured at the base of the nail. This condition requires immobilization in extension; would you like me to request X-ray images to rule out an associated avulsion fracture?

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
